about: Lumbridge church and its graveyard, east of the castle: Father Aereck (father_aereck, 2812) and the Prayer tutor (aide_tutor_prayer, 3223) inside, Nigel the Deadman tutor (deadman_nigel, 6093, which shows as Nigel, 8391, on a normal world) in the graveyard and Count Check (count_check, 7414) south-west of it. Tiles are RSMod's rev 233 Lumbridge spawns, checked against the 241 map (the church's walls and pews). Every wander range is guessed (2, Father Aereck 5 inside) until recorded.

spawns.source: Father Aereck, in the church by the altar. RSMod rev 233 Lumbridge spawns
Prayer tutor, in the church by the north door. RSMod rev 233 Lumbridge spawns
Nigel, in the graveyard. RSMod rev 233 Lumbridge spawns
Count Check, south-west of the graveyard. RSMod rev 233 Lumbridge spawns
